thesis: Strategy v1 (2026-11-11). HOLD $1,000 cash; review next completed UTC Coinbase bar, with multiweek allocation horizon. Nov 26 CoinDesk morning reporting places BTC near $60,500 after a rebound from roughly $57,500; this is an intraday report, not a completed Coinbase bar. The Block and CoinDesk report about $453m Wednesday ETF withdrawals, seventh consecutive negative session, and $5.39bn month-to-date through Nov 25, attributed to SoSoValue, not independent on-chain evidence. Cash remains preferable today given persistent demand weakness and only one positive five-day reading; no requirement to wait for a full SMA crossover if stabilization becomes convincing. Reconsider $50-150 BTC if the next two completed closes sustain positive five-day returns and hold above $59,740.87 (Nov 24 close), particularly if fund withdrawals ease when US markets reopen, or if BTC regains SMA20 with improving momentum. ETH has a plausible network adoption thesis but no verified fresh distinct catalyst here and reported $1.30bn monthly ETH ETF withdrawals; SOL, LINK and ADA have modest completed rebounds but no substantiated independent thesis sufficient to prefer them over BTC/cash net of costs. Other eligible coins lack current collector marks. No SELL possible. Nov 25 matched equity $1,000 versus BTC $794.843453, $205.16 lead from cash exposure, not validated forecasting skill. Prior month null, no monthly review due; no strategy revision warranted.
